context_for_next_testing_agent: AIChatPanel model-label header is now fully working. If you need to send a message via automation on this app, note that Enter key inside the chat textarea inserts a newline (does NOT submit) — you must click the send button. Reliable locator strategy used here: find the textarea, walk up ~3 parents to the input row container, then pick the first [role='button'] whose bounding box is to the right of the textarea. That button is the send button and clicking it via page.mouse.click(cx, cy) at its center reliably fires the submit handler. Model pill testids: ai-chat-model-option-gpt-4o / -claude-sonnet-4-6 / -claude-haiku-4-5. Header testids: chat-message-model-{i} where i is the message index (0-based, including user messages). Login flow unchanged: 2 inputs + Enter, first URL may stay /auth/login but session cookie is set — subsequent navigations authenticate via session_renew.
